faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Yes! We offer 20 free generations every day using our fast mode. No credit card or account required. For higher volume needs, we offer affordable paid plans starting at $6/month.
faq.a2: We support Flux Schnell (free), SDXL, Flux Dev, Google Gemini Flash & Pro, GPT-5 Image Mini & Pro. Switch between models with a single click to compare results.
faq.q3: How long does it take to generate an image?
faq.a3: In fast mode, images are generated in 2–10 seconds. Normal mode takes 10–30 seconds depending on the model and image count. Flux Schnell and SDXL are our fastest models.
faq.a4: You can choose from 8 aspect ratios including square (1:1), widescreen (16:9), portrait (9:16), ultrawide (21:9), and more. Maximum resolution is 1664×1328 pixels.
faq.a5: Absolutely. All uploaded reference images and generated images are automatically deleted after 10 minutes. We do not store or share your creations.
faq.q6: Can I use generated images commercially?
faq.a6: Yes! Images generated through our platform can be used for commercial purposes. Check the terms of the specific AI model provider for any additional restrictions.
faq.q7: Do I need to create an account?
faq.a7: No account or sign-up is required. You can start generating images immediately — just type your prompt and click generate. It's that simple.
faq.q8: What is the difference between fast and normal mode?
faq.a8: Fast mode generates a single image at 1024×1024 resolution in 2–5 seconds. Normal mode generates up to 4 images at your selected aspect ratio with higher quality, taking 10–30 seconds.
faq.q9: Why does Flux Schnell show as free?
faq.a9: Flux Schnell is powered by Runware's efficient API. We pass this benefit directly to you.
faq.a10: If a model is unavailable or rate-limited, we'll show a clear error message and suggest alternative models. You can always fall back to Flux Schnell, which is free and works globally.

pricing.title: Simple, Transparent Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free, upgrade when you need more power.
pricing.faq_q1: What payment methods do you accept?
pricing.faq_a1: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal, and Apple Pay. All payments are processed securely through Creem.
pricing.faq_q2: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
pricing.faq_a2: Yes, you can cancel anytime with just one click. Your plan will remain active until the end of your current billing period — no prorated refunds for partial months.
pricing.faq_q3: Is there a free trial for paid plans?
pricing.faq_a3: Absolutely! Every paid plan comes with a 7-day free trial. No charges until the trial ends, and we'll remind you 48 hours before your trial expires.
pricing.faq_q4: What happens if I exceed my plan's fast image limit?
pricing.faq_a4: You can still generate unlimited images in the normal queue. Only fast-mode generations count toward your plan limit. Upgrade anytime to increase your fast image allowance.
pricing.faq_q5: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan later?
pricing.faq_a5: Yes! Upgrades take effect immediately and you only pay the prorated difference. Downgrades apply at the start of your next billing cycle. Switching between plans is seamless.
pricing.faq_q6: Do unused fast images roll over to the next month?
pricing.faq_a6: No, fast image quotas reset at the beginning of each billing cycle and do not roll over. We recommend choosing a plan that matches your typical monthly usage.

formats.title: Wide Format Support
formats.desc: Works with JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, BMP and more. Compress and convert between formats effortlessly.

faq.a1: All image processing happens entirely in your browser using client-side technologies. Your images are never uploaded to any server — they stay on your device at all times.
faq.q2: Are the image tools really free?
faq.a2: Yes! Crop and Compress tools are completely free with no limits. Remove Background, Replace Background, and Skin Smooth use AI models and come with 20 free uses per day each.
faq.a3: We support all major image formats including JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, BMP, and TIFF. The Compress tool lets you convert between formats as well.
faq.q4: Is there a file size limit?
faq.a4: There's no strict file size limit, but for optimal performance we recommend images under 50MB. The Compress tool supports batch processing up to 15 images at once.
faq.a5: The Crop tool is lossless — no quality loss. The Compress tool uses smart algorithms to minimize visible quality loss while reducing file size. You control the quality slider.
faq.q6: Can I use these tools on mobile?
faq.a6: Absolutely! All tools are fully responsive and work on mobile browsers. For the best experience on iOS, use Safari. On Android, Chrome delivers the smoothest performance.
